name: Pinta (GTK 3)
description:
Pinta is a free, open-source bitmap image editor and digital painting application modeled after Paint.NET. It provides an accessible yet powerful set of drawing tools and image adjustment filters in a clean GTK3 interface.

Features:
- Multi-layer editing with adjustable blending modes and layer transparency
- Drawing tools including freehand brushes, pencils, shapes, gradients, and erasers
- Over 35 image adjustments and artistic effects (sharpen, blur, emboss, glow)
- Full history tracking with unlimited undo and redo capabilities
- Multi-language support and cross-platform consistency
